items.title: Genie Migrate can convert T-SQL to Lakeflow pipelines (Beta)
items.text: Genie Migrate can convert T-SQL scripts from SQL Server and Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools into Lakeflow pipelines. This target framework is in Beta. In a T-SQL migration project, choose the Spark Declarative Pipelines target framework, organize your files into groups, and choose a catalog and schema for each group. Each group becomes one serverless pipeline that Genie Migrate validates with a dry run. To use this target, a workspace admin turns on Migration Projects Experimental Features from the Previews page. See Manage Azure Databricks previews. See Supported source dialects and target frameworks.

items.title: Files API 3.0 will soon be generally available
items.text: Files API 3.0 for Unity Catalog volumes will soon be generally available. Starting in December 2026, it will also be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. The Files API supports reading, writing, listing, and deleting files and directories in Unity Catalog volumes by path. Version 3.0 adds multipart uploads for files larger than 5 GB and conditional operations that prevent unintended changes by checking the current file version before upload, download, or deletion. See Use the Files API with Unity Catalog volumes for more information.
